featuredArticle.title: How to Work Aged Leads: The Complete System for Maximum ROI
featuredArticle.spotlight: A test only means something if you work every batch the same way, and this piece lays out that repeatable process: scripts, follow-up sequences, and the economics behind aged leads. It's worth revisiting before your next test, because a consistent system is your control group. Without one, you can't tell whether a weak result came from the leads or from how you worked them.
